standard_prerequisites.name: Presentation existence
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes X = [U/R] for a smooth groupoid in algebraic spaces.

standard_prerequisites.name: Change of big site for quotient stacks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Groupoids in Spaces, lemma quotient-stack-change-big-site (cross-chapter, named)

standard_prerequisites.name: Preservation of the groupoid type
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: the evident functoriality of f^{-1} on morphisms of algebraic spaces (structural)
standard_prerequisites.use: f^{-1}U, f^{-1}R, f^{-1}s, f^{-1}t, f^{-1}c form a smooth (resp. etale) groupoid again.

core_obligations: (3): write X = [U/R] via the presentation lemma; f^{-1}[U/R] = [f^{-1}U/f^{-1}R] by the change-of-site lemma; the pulled groupoid is smooth; conclude by the quotient-stack theorem.
(1): representability by a scheme X means the presentation [X/X]; the translation gives f^{-1}X represented by the same scheme in the bigger site.
(2): representability by an algebraic space F means [F/F]; the translation gives f^{-1}F.
(4): a Deligne-Mumford stack admits an etale presentation; the same translation preserves etaleness of the groupoid.
proof_roadmap: Presentation translation for (3); same mechanism for (1), (2), (4) with the kind-specific groupoid.
difficulty_reason: The (3) case is a real two-step argument; the other three are the identical mechanism with the kind of presentation changed (template shown in-span).
